# GitHub repository About

Help your community grow. Members stay. Visitors convert. One knowledge base. Open-source AI support for community channels and website chat, available hosted or self-hosted.

Verified `agent-skills` and `workflow-automation` are real, active topic pages (github.com/topics/agent-skills, github.com/topics/workflow-automation) worth keeping.
